name: wavelet coefficients
definition_zh: 信号与相应尺度及位置的小波函数作用得到的变换系数。
usage_overview: 小波系数用于表征信号在不同位置和尺度上的局部特征，在轨道不平顺与车体振动响应分析中，可据此考察信号局部特征随位置和尺度的变化。

complete_examples.text: By selecting appropriate wavelet functions, the track irregularity and car -body vibration signal were transformed through continues wavelet method, and then the time -frequency feature of the track irregularity was analyzed by setting the wavelet coefficients as the evaluation index of the track smooth state.
wavelet coefficients 铁路轨道是一种特殊的结构物,它大多支承在密实度和弹性都很不均匀的道床和路基上,其工作条件十分复杂,承受很大的随机性列车动荷载的反复作用。
